---
title: "Phase-stability grids for aqueous MDEA and AMP"
format: html
---

Full found a finite Gibbs decrease in both reactive parents. Neither composition
grid found a decrease at denominators 2 or 4. The union recovered both witnesses
through Full. The grids measured how far the refused nodes lay from evaluated
compositions on each density side.

The MDEA parent is at 363.15 K and 262861919.71783307 Pa, with 1.7987685418415897 mol
water and 1.368 mol CO₂ per mol MDEA. The AMP parent is at 393.15 K and
1215282.4561119014 Pa, with 30.0 wt% AMP before loading and 0.700 mol CO₂ per mol AMP.
The replay uses fixed-temperature, fixed-pressure single-liquid parents, the
supplied reactions, and aqueous standards. It reuses the same compiled system and
accepted parent for both independent searches in each case. The model reports
that the MDEA pressure exceeds the parameter metadata’s 10 MPa upper bound.
The replay tests the equations at that extrapolated pressure.

[Amine-Thermodynamics at f30977a3](https://github.com/tannerpolley/Amine-Thermodynamics/tree/f30977a3)
supplies the parameters, reaction laws, feed, reference declarations, and
two-liquid solutions. The parent and split JSON files give the exact source
paths and preserve component order. The MIT notice accompanies those files.
The runner loads reference split compositions after the blind searches.

## Blind searches

The table reports the most negative resolved finite withdrawal in each search
and its estimated numerical error, both in mol on the declared feed basis.
The union selects the best witness from the two independent records. Its work
and single-run elapsed time are the sums for those searches. Density evaluations
are included in the total EOS evaluations. Full ran 60 finite withdrawal
attempts for MDEA and four for AMP. Neither grid started a withdrawal or
requested local refinement.

Full supplies both TPD values and separate donor-slope errors in the replay
records. A raw grid TPD uncertainty estimates reduced molar energy and
arithmetic errors conditional on the frozen parent plane. Both the first and
minimum grid TPD are raw, independently pressure-closed evaluations. [The replay records](results/mdea-amp.jsonl)
retain the reported values, refusals, work, and timing for both denominators. Tables show
the recorded scalar comparisons directly, including cases with unavailable
coverage.

## Achieved composition coverage

Each liquid schedule uses the full reactive support. Each vapor schedule uses
the neutral amine, carbon dioxide and water. All planned distinct nodes were
visited. The raw counts before deduplication are 51 and 510 for MDEA and 72 and
1,016 for AMP at $m=2$ and $m=4$, respectively.

| Case | $m$ | Density side | Admitted / planned | $h$ (L1) | Planned rounding bound |
|---|---:|---|---:|---:|---:|
| MDEA | 2 | Liquid | 23/44 | 1 | 2 |
| MDEA | 2 | Vapor | 0/6 | unavailable | 1.5 |
| MDEA | 4 | Liquid | 344/450 | 0.5 | 2 |
| MDEA | 4 | Vapor | 0/15 | unavailable | 0.75 |
| AMP | 2 | Liquid | 29/63 | 1 | 2 |
| AMP | 2 | Vapor | 4/6 | 1 | 1.5 |
| AMP | 4 | Liquid | 585/825 | 0.5 | 2 |
| AMP | 4 | Vapor | 10/15 | 1 | 0.75 |

The largest outward-rounded mapping allowance was $4.17\times10^{-16}$ in
species mole-fraction L1 distance. The attained discrete coverage improved
with denominator on both liquid supports. Only the AMP vapor grid at $m=4$
has a combined rounding, admission and mapping bound below the simplex
diameter of 2. On the liquid schedules, the density search reported
nonfinite derivatives for 20 and 105 MDEA nodes and 33 and 238 AMP nodes, in
increasing denominator order. The other liquid gaps had unresolved root
sides. All vapor gaps had unresolved or wrong-side roots. At $m=4$ the
refused liquid nodes used 106 root calls and 270 EOS evaluations for MDEA,
and 240 root calls and 595 EOS evaluations for AMP. A direct integer-distance
comparison agreed with the reported $h$ and nearest admitted identities on
every schedule with admitted nodes.

Coverage applies to composition distance within the represented support and
density side. Charged vapor lies outside the declared schedules. The grid
does not bound TPD away from evaluated nodes or enumerate every mechanical
branch. Its absence of a witness leaves the Full witnesses decisive as
numerical verification of model instability.

## Separate two-liquid replay

A solve started from the retained split endpoints passed the declared row
criterion for each case. The extensive objective differences were
$-4.50549748\times10^{-5}$ mol for MDEA and $-0.01618322237$ mol for AMP.
The source reports an estimated error of $2.79\times10^{-9}$ mol for the
AMP coexistence calculation. It supplies no total error for the retained MDEA
coexistence result. These model calculations supply evidence about the
declared equations and do not validate phase behavior against observations.

## Donor slope under feed rescaling

The manufactured isomerisation check at 180 K and 100 kPa uses the same
composition and feeds differing by a factor of 1,000. The corrected donor-slope
estimate is $3.93665\times10^{-14}$ on both bases, with the same Full withdrawal
admissions. The original estimates were $4.09208\times10^{-14}$ and
$1.63098\times10^{-12}$, outside the $7.10543\times10^{-15}$ arithmetic
comparison criterion. The extensive repair contribution remains in the finite
split estimate. Against main `6df8953a`, the recorded ordinary Full admissions,
states and work agreed for both reactive parents.

The replay was run with the Engine at `47d83ed0`. Manuscript promotion remains
open.
